Made a free “API Drop Zone” – paste any API URL, hit send, get results instantly an alternative to postman
Hi everyone,
I often got tired of opening Postman or writing quick curl commands just to test a single API call. So I built a little side project: apivalidation.com.

https://apivalidation.com

It’s basically a one-page API testing tool:
	•	Enter your API endpoint
	•	Pick the method (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
	•	Instantly see JSON/text response in the browser

No downloads, no setup, no signup. Just drop the API and test.

It’s still early, but I’m planning to add:
	•	Authentication support
	•	Save/share requests
	•	Bulk testing

I’d love to know:
	•	Would this actually save you time vs curl/Postman?
	•	What features should I prioritize?
	•	Anything annoying in the current version?

Thanks for checking it out 🙌
